newsitem.title: USA: Nevada Gold names Elizabeth Woods CFO.
newsitem.headline: Nevada Gold names Elizabeth Woods CFO.

text.p: Nevada Gold & Casinos Inc said on Tuesday that it has appointed Elizabeth Woods to the newly created position of chief financial officer and treasurer.
Previously, Woods was senior vice president and controller for Post Oak Bank in Houston, the company said.
Nevada Gold chairman and chief executive officer H. Thomas Winn had previously fulfilled the duties of chief financial officer, a company spokesman said.
